_comment: Copy this file to metadata-instances.json and replace the truth values according to the comments. The truth value file is excluded by .gitignore and must not be committed. api_key is the bearer token for the tdai kernel gateway, obtained from the kernel side. proxy_endpoint is optional and only affects the UI 'Client Access Address' display; when running the open-source core+proxy separately locally, fill in the proxy's external address (e.g., http://127.0.0.1:8096), and omit it when the online/network gateway is fronted by a proxy.

instances.name: E2E Automated Testing Specific (Can Clear Database at Any Time)
